limitations: Inspection-only review of frozen source, inventories, histories and supplied adapter; no network, payload acquisition, container build or scientific execution. Missing annex/binary payloads are capture omissions, not observed retrieval failures.

Only the assigned anonymized assessment was reviewed; no peer reviews, prior assessments, source evaluation fixtures or external issue-thread contents were read. Probe claims embedded in the assessment were not accepted as independent evidence, and original probe output was not supplied as an allowed review input.

Historical exit-zero records support observed past executions but do not independently establish present reproducibility, scientific validity, current access, or human approval. The adapter source was supplied under a version-tag URL; its frozen manifest SHA256, not tag immutability, anchors this review.
